details: The Strait of Hormuz crisis has re-escalated, with the United States striking three Iranian oil tankers on September 5, following Iranian attacks against US naval vessels. Iran has also issued warnings to vessels using routes it deems unauthorized, leading to traffic through the vital Strait nearing historic lows. This escalation is significantly impacting crude and diesel markets, with global diesel inventories reported to be well below last year's levels.
sourceName: Substack (Energy Politics Update by Dr. Jennifer I Considine)
title: Hormuz Crisis Re-escalates: US Strikes Iranian Oil Tankers

details: Bitcoin rallied above $81,000 this past week, in part due to a perceived "Iran de-escalation relief" following US President Trump's comments on Wednesday that airstrikes were "short-lived." This reduction in geopolitical risk premium, alongside massive ETF inflows and Ethereum's strong performance, helped Bitcoin break a pattern where macro events previously dominated crypto prices.
title: Iran De-escalation Contributed to Bitcoin Rally Last Week

details: Hackers have reportedly stolen approximately 4,000 Bitcoins, valued at around $320 million, from a Liquid Network wallet after a security breach. The Liquid Network has temporarily suspended new transactions and apologized to its users for the disruption.
title: Liquid Network Suffers $320 Million Bitcoin Hack

details: Beijing is reportedly preparing a substantial £40 billion stimulus package aimed at its financial sector. The initiative is intended to boost investment in the stock market and help replenish cash reserves for banks and insurers, in response to concerns over sluggish economic growth in the country.
title: China Prepares £40 Billion Financial Stimulus

details: A Ukrainian presidential adviser has issued a dire warning that "nobody will win" and both Ukraine and Russia face mutual destruction if the ongoing conflict continues. This statement underscores the severe and entrenched nature of the war, highlighting persistent geopolitical instability in Eastern Europe.
title: Zelenskyy Adviser Warns of Mutual Destruction in Russia War
